label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss): User-controlled 'state' parameter flows into session attribute key lookup. The 'redirect' value retrieved from session.getAttribute('oauth_state_' + state) is attacker-controllable if an attacker can manipulate session storage or perform replay attacks. The sendRedirect sink receives this unresolved user-dependent value. While redirect.startsWith('/') provides some filtering, it does not sanitize the value itself - an attacker could craft malicious redirects within allowed prefixes.

evidence.note: User state param -> session lookup -> sendRedirect sink
